title: Street Fighter Alpha 2 (CPS-2 Recomp)
description: CPS-2 Recomp: unofficial native PC ports of Capcom CPS-2 arcade games (Street Fighter Alpha 2, Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo, Vampire Savior) via static recompilation, with training modes, in one launcher: macOS, Linux, Steam Deck, Windows. Requires your own ROM sets. Beta.
